name: Between Rails and Talks
source:
Between Rails and Talks is a Visual Novel game that tells the story of two characters: Patrick, the elder mobster-like demon, and Parker the younger artsy ADHD one.

[From [url=https://lemonnleaf.itch.io/between-rails-and-talks]itch.io[/url]]
